Subtract 28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Plus 6 days = total 202 days earlier.  

1348 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
Days before Jan 8, 1348:  
Back 202 days:

- Dec has 31 days, Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31, Jun 30, May 31, Apr 30, Mar 31, Feb 29 (leap year), Jan 31.  
Count back:  
From 1347-12-31:

Nov: 30 → 1347-11-01 → 133 left.  
Oct: 31 → 1347-10-01 → 102 left.

June has 30 days, so 10 days before July 1 is June 21.
